How it works

Don't pay until you review 6 scripts. Get your ads in 12–16 days. Full refund if you don't love them.
Don't pay until you review 6 scripts
  1. 1
    Today

    Build your brief

    Choose your product, creator types, & formats from our curated library (skits, street interviews, & more).

  2. 2
    0-24 hours

    Meet your Creative Director

    Talk through your brief live. Share brand guidelines, winning & losing ads, & anything we should know.

  3. 3
    24 hours

    Review 6 scripts

    We research your product & competitors, then write 6 unique scripts for you to review before you pay. Or use your own scripts.

  4. 4
    48–72 hours

    Reminder, then billing

    At 48 hours, you get a reminder. At 72 hours, you're charged $1000. If you don’t love your ads, get a full refund.

Get your ads in 12–16 days
  1. 5
    2–8 days (after product arrives)

    Human creators film your ads

    We ship products to creators. Your Creative Director coaches them as they film your scripts & B-roll.

  2. 6
    Begins as footage arrives

    Human editors edit your ads

    Our editors cut footage and add graphics, captions, & sound. Your Creative Director checks every ad.

  3. 7
    12–16 days (after product arrives)

    Get 6 Human UGC ads

    Unlimited human revisions. Your ads, raw footage, & B-roll are yours (full usage rights included).

Don't pay until you review 6 scripts. Get your ads in 12–16 days. Full refund if you don't love them.

Done-for-you creative

  • 6 Human UGC ads (no AI / 100% real): 2 creators × 3 ads each (all unique concepts / no variations). We find creators, ship products, curate formats, write scripts, coach creators, & edit videos (managed by your Creative Director).
  • Human Creative Director: talk through your brief live in your first 24 hours. Share brand guidelines, winning + losing ads, & anything we should know. You’ll also get a shared Slack channel.
  • World-class creative team: 1288+ vetted creators (who've worked with IM8, k2o, immi), human scriptwriters ($80M+ in Meta adspend), & 200+ in-house video editors (100K+ ads edited). We pay creators above-market.
  • Curated ad format library: Skits, street interviews, product demos, & more. Updated daily with formats our Creative Directors see winning across their brands.
  • Powered by Admaker 2.0 software: Helps our creative team make better ads. Helps your team track progress, review + launch + analyze ads, & rebook creators. Replaces Billo, Soona, SideShift, Insense, Motion, Foreplay, & more ($10K+/mo).
  • 12–16 day delivery (after creators receive product): physical + digital products supported.

Risk-free & flexible

  • Don't pay until you review 6 scripts: 24-hour delivery, 3-day free trial, & billing reminder. Or bring your own scripts.
  • 100% money-back guarantee: Full refund if you don’t love your ads.
  • Unlimited human revisions: our creators, scriptwriters, & editors revise until you’re happy.
  • You own all assets: final ads, raw footage, & B-roll are yours (full usage rights included).
